handoff: Approve: all 5 criteria traced to tests (core hookAnswer pins the cli's turn-end block; adapters encode deny/context per tool, allow otherwise; toolCall over payloads); test+typecheck green. 2 minor notes: Codex shell-name comment, doc-sourced Codex/Gemini encodings.

findings.title: SHELL_TOOLS comment says Codex reports Bash, but the set guesses three more names
findings.detail:
The comment reads "Codex reports its shell tool as `Bash` in hook payloads." while the set adds `shell`, `local_shell`, `exec_command`, none observed (handoff: 'its shell tool names beyond Bash ... taken from the tools' docs'). Possible Speculative Generality; the comment misleads a reader about why the extra names are there.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say why the extra names are kept (older or alternate Codex tool names per its docs), or drop them until observed.

findings.title: Codex and Gemini deny/context encodings and apply_patch shape are hand-written from docs
findings.detail:
The slice notes ask to 'record real ones where possible and say in the handoff which Codex and Gemini encodings are taken from docs, not observed'. The handoff says so under Not proven yet; the tests prove the encoding matches the docs, not that the tools honour it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Record real payloads and an observed deny/context round-trip before slices 05-07 rely on them.
